strategy_audit.name: current_kalman_flip
strategy_audit.label: Current bot, 1m Kalman Trend fresh flip
strategy_audit.confirmation: one live candidate per day, highest slope among a simultaneous flip
strategy_audit.ranking: first flip across the day's bands, then highest slope
strategy_audit.deviation: Only the 1m flip arm is replayed. The live four-frame VWAP pullback arm is not tested because its 1D frame needs 40 completed daily bars that the band store does not hold.

strategy_audit.name: 1_ema_rsi_pullback
strategy_audit.label: EMA 20/50 + RSI pullback
strategy_audit.entry: 15m EMA20 above EMA50, 15m RSI recovers through 50 after a 40-50 pullback, 5m close above the prior high
strategy_audit.confirmation: the 5m breakout is the trigger; the optional 1H EMA50 filter is not enforced
strategy_audit.ranking: first qualifying 5m slot, highest score inside that slot
strategy_audit.deviation: The optional 1H EMA50 filter is omitted. The 5m close above the prior high is an added trigger.

strategy_audit.name: 2_vwap_reclaim_relvol
strategy_audit.label: VWAP reclaim + relative volume
strategy_audit.entry: 5m close above session VWAP after the prior 5m close was at or below it
strategy_audit.confirmation: the following 5m close above VWAP and relative volume of at least 1.5; a separate retest is not required
strategy_audit.ranking: first qualifying slot, highest prior-slot relative volume
strategy_audit.deviation: The separate retest in the written specification is not required.

strategy_audit.name: 3_kalman_vwap_rs
strategy_audit.label: Kalman 1H/15M + VWAP + relative strength
strategy_audit.entry: 1H and 15M Kalman state +1, 5m close above VWAP, positive RS20, 5m close above the prior high
strategy_audit.confirmation: the 15m and 1h filters are completed before the 5m trigger
strategy_audit.ranking: first qualifying slot, highest RS20 plus VWAP distance
strategy_audit.deviation: The market leg of RS20 is the equal-weight mean of captured KMIALL symbols, not the KMIALLSHR index level.

strategy_audit.name: 4_donchian_atr_breakout
strategy_audit.label: Donchian breakout + ATR + relative volume
strategy_audit.entry: 15m close above the prior 20-bar high but within 0.75%, ATR expanding, 1h close above EMA50, relative volume at least 1.5, 5m close above the Donchian high
strategy_audit.confirmation: the 5m entry must not exceed the Donchian high by more than 0.75%
strategy_audit.ranking: first qualifying slot, highest relative volume plus ATR expansion
strategy_audit.deviation: The suggested 0.25% to 0.90% normalized ATR band is not a hard gate. A 0.75% anti-chase cap is added.

strategy_audit.name: 5_supertrend_adx_volume
strategy_audit.label: Supertrend + ADX + volume expansion
strategy_audit.entry: bullish Supertrend, ADX above 20, +DI above -DI, relative volume at least 1.3, 5m close above the prior high
strategy_audit.deviation: The separate controlled pullback qualifier is not enforced.

strategy_audit.name: 6_bollinger_squeeze
strategy_audit.label: Bollinger squeeze + volume breakout
strategy_audit.entry: 15m band width below its prior 100-observation 20th percentile, 15m close above the upper band within 1%, 1h close above EMA50, relative volume at least 1.5, 5m close above the upper band
strategy_audit.confirmation: the 1h 'not bearish' test is close above EMA50
strategy_audit.ranking: first qualifying slot, highest relative volume
strategy_audit.deviation: The written specification's 1h condition is represented only by close above EMA50.

strategy_audit.name: 7_rsi_ema50_reversal
strategy_audit.label: RSI reversal + EMA 50 support
strategy_audit.entry: 15m RSI touched 30-45 in the last five bars and crossed back above 45, 1h close above EMA50, higher low, 5m close above the prior high
strategy_audit.confirmation: the 1h trend and the higher low are both required
strategy_audit.ranking: first qualifying slot, largest RSI recovery
strategy_audit.deviation: No separate written-specification gate beyond the 1h EMA50 and the higher low is omitted.

strategy_audit.name: 8_opening_range_vwap
strategy_audit.label: Opening range breakout + VWAP
strategy_audit.entry: 5m close above the first completed 15m high and above VWAP, relative volume at least 1.5
strategy_audit.confirmation: a session whose tape starts after the open has no opening range and cannot signal
strategy_audit.ranking: first qualifying slot, highest relative volume
strategy_audit.deviation: The anti-chase cap allows at most 0.5% above the opening-range high.

strategy_audit.name: 9_relative_strength_rotation
strategy_audit.label: Relative strength rotation
strategy_audit.entry: 15m RS8 and RS20 positive, close above EMA20, adequate turnover; the next 5m close above the prior 5m high
strategy_audit.confirmation: the 5m confirmation is the entry trigger
strategy_audit.ranking: 0.60 z(RS8) + 0.40 z(RS4), highest cross-sectional score, at least three names
strategy_audit.deviation: The market is the equal-weight captured universe, not the KMIALLSHR index. The 1h RS component named in the note is not an explicit gate.

strategy_audit.name: 10_order_book_imbalance
strategy_audit.label: Order book imbalance + VWAP + intensity
strategy_audit.timeframes: order book and 60 second trade intensity
strategy_audit.deviation: The capture has last price, best bid, best ask and print sizes, but not top-five depth or a reliable aggressor sequence. Computing imbalance would fabricate the missing book.
strategy_audit.source: no implementation; refused by the original study

data_standard.complete_definition: The capture's first observation is at or before the regular session open, its last observation is at or after the last regular close minus one minute, and every band is covered. A trading day with no stored capture is missing, never a holiday and never padded.
requirements: raw capture preservation and SHA-256 hashes
at least 60 complete sessions before a preliminary comparison
preferably 100 or more complete sessions across market regimes
data_standard.monitor_scope: research only; no live signal, target, stop, notification or broker change
